name: github-mcp
description: GitHub CLI MCP servers for pull requests, issues, CI, repositories, and other GitHub workflows, with shared lifecycle hooks that steer agents to the MCP tools.

args: plugin_base="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/plugins/cache/github-agent-tools/github-mcp"; plugin_root=; for candidate in "$plugin_base"/*; do [[ -x "$candidate/mcp-server-gh/server-$1.sh" ]] || continue; if [[ -z "$plugin_root" || "$candidate" -nt "$plugin_root" ]]; then plugin_root="$candidate"; fi; done; if [[ -z "$plugin_root" ]]; then printf 'github-mcp: installed plugin runtime not found under %s\n' "$plugin_base" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$plugin_root/mcp-server-gh/server-$1.sh"

plugin_base="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/plugins/cache/github-agent-tools/github-mcp"; plugin_root=; for candidate in "$plugin_base"/*; do [[ -x "$candidate/mcp-server-gh/server-$1.sh" ]] || continue; if [[ -z "$plugin_root" || "$candidate" -nt "$plugin_root" ]]; then plugin_root="$candidate"; fi; done; if [[ -z "$plugin_root" ]]; then printf 'github-mcp: installed plugin runtime not found under %s\n' "$plugin_base" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$plugin_root/mcp-server-gh/server-$1.sh"

interface.shortDescription: Use GitHub CLI workflows through MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Adds read and opt-in write MCP servers backed by the authenticated GitHub CLI, plus hooks that steer GitHub operations away from raw shell commands.
defaultPrompt: Use GitHub MCP to inspect the pull request for this branch.
Use GitHub MCP to diagnose the latest failing CI run.
